title: FISTS WHOOSH AND THUD
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sound and give actions a distinct noise. A bare-hand swing that missed played a footstep, and one that landed played the thin ping the menus use to say no, so a punch on a pillager sounded like a tap on a machine. Now every swing whooshes through the air, so a miss reads as a miss, and a blow that lands thuds: the hit of what it struck (a body or a machine), a heavy knock and a short smack. Your teammate hears the punch where it landed. Sound only: nothing in the raid changes.
now: Bare hands now whoosh on every swing and thud when the blow lands.

edits.anchor: // v23.90, HIS ORDER 2026-10-12 (his #45, improve all sound as much as possible): FOOTSTEPS ON WHAT IS UNDER THEM.

edits.replacement: if(!G.sim){ spark(_me.x,_me.y,'#cdd6dd',10,200); sfx('punch',_me.x,_me.y,entMat(_me)); }   // v24.xx (sndA4): a blow that lands thuds on what it struck
if(!G.sim&&fromPlayer) blip('swing');   // v24.xx (sndA4): every swing whooshes (a miss played a footstep)
